_meta.purpose: Evidence gate for Pipeline V2 (plan sec.6A). Every cutaway asset must have an entry here BEFORE it appears in a timeline. A cutaway without a registry entry, or whose privacy_status is not 'cleared', is a build failure.

schema.permission: who authorized use, or citation requirement
schema.supports_transcript_lines: exact transcript sentence(s) this asset supports
